pairs.why: B is the armless folding chair with a fabric back panel and crossed tube legs like the real card, while A is a chunky armchair with swollen lime-trimmed fabric.
Both are armchairs, but A keeps the all-green fabric and grey tubes of the real card, while B's orange armrests add a colour mass the real card doesn't have.
A and B are near-identical thin-frame armless chairs with the same lime green and stiff wire look, so there is nothing real to pick between them.
B matches the real card's armless build, back panel between the posts and X legs, while A adds armrests and a bulkier toy-like frame.
B is built like the real armless folding chair, while A is an armchair with orange armrests that change both the shape and the colour masses.
B has the real card's armless shape, back panel set between upright posts, deeper green fabric and soft crossed legs, while A is an orange-armed armchair.
Even though B's tubes are a little thin and crisp, its armless folding structure and all-green fabric are much closer than A's orange-armed armchair.
A is the clean armless folding chair like the real card, while B is a chunky, swollen armchair with lime trim.
